title: Thai Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: Juicy chicken in a rich and flavorful curry sauce, inspired by the bold spices of Jamaican cuisine with a hint of Thai flavors. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same pan, add the chopped spring onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the quick curry sauce, coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Return the chicken breast to the pan and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional spring onions, if desired.
